notes: LFM3-Omni-2B_depth_frame2_f32.tflite, published 2026-11-01 in the speech/ folder of litert-community/LFM3-Omni-2B-LiteRT (LiquidAI/LFM3-Omni-2B at revision ce2458cb, LFM Open License v1.0): speech output: the depth decoder for a whole frame in one call (the projection, the 3 passes and the sampler inside the graph, the codes as the only output, each draw scaled by its codebook's cdf total). App rows: the photo voice chat sample (a litert-samples app; the builds of its tree, the APK in each signature) opens the bundle's sections and the speech graphs with LiteRT 2.3.0's Kotlin CompiledModel, not through LiteRT-LM; its engine also held the hold's other depth graphs open, and only the graphs named in a signature ran in those answers or readings; airplane mode, a heat gate before each answer or reading (the gate lines in the score files and run.log); the holds' logcat and delegate files hold the delegation lines, which these records do not parse; os_build = the Android version in the app's report (no build id). LANDED: speech/LFM3-Omni-2B_depth_frame2_f32.tflite is in the Hub tree of litert-community/LFM3-Omni-2B-LiteRT from upload commit 6fcfc2e9aade88c5fb1ac76e6967b5470672710b (2026-11-01T03:03:54Z); the anonymous tree read at 2026-11-01T12:09:49+09:00 (main a287b6e6) gives LFS oid 19646b570f453711a60add2523febb4884e3214e8c3b7f5ca898dc29dae3d60a and 435,046,636 B = artifact_sha256 (the omni_depth_frame2_f32.tflite).
